{{TournamentPageStart|twitchid=lec|toclimit=2|text=The '''LEC 2025 Spring Season''' is the second split of the third year of EMEA's unified professional League of Legends league. In Stage 1, ten teams compete in a best-of-three single round robin group stage, with the top six advancing to Playoffs, a double elimination bracket.}}
==Overview==
=== Format ===
* Regular Season (Stage 1):
** 10 teams participate
** Single Round Robin
** All matches are best of three
** Matches use "Hard Fearless Draft", champions can only be picked once by either team during the series
** Top six teams advance to [[LEC/2025 Season/Spring Playoffs|Playoffs]]
